paragraphs: Gecko sells a student engagement platform to colleges and universities. The tools are described as designed exclusively for higher education and built around AI. Enquiries from every channel land in a single inbox for staff to answer.

Modules include AI chatbots deployed across departments to give instant answers around the clock. Texting supports personalized, AI-driven conversations with students. Event tools automate registrations, reminders, and follow-ups for open days. Some teams run Gecko in place of a heavier CRM, using tags, custom fields, dynamic lists, and engagement tracking. The company positions that as a step up from email-only tools. It says a school can be up and running with Gecko in a week.

The company states that its technology has helped institutions engage with more than 10 million students around the world. Beyond recruitment, the site describes using the platform for alumni engagement. Documented use cases also include college fair strategy with custom QR codes, automated follow-ups, and real-time lead capture.

quote.text: Gecko technology has helped smart institutions engage with more than 10 million students from all over the world.
